messages:
amira: Heads-up: we're GA-ing SDK v4.1.0 next week. Two primary changes: client telemetry is opt-in by default (privacy-first) and the legacy ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json file is deprecated in favor of the new per-process --runtime-config v2. Full migration guide: https://go.redwood/docs/sdk-v4-1-migration :loudspeaker:
noah: Will this break hosted customers or just those that used the flags file?
jen: Short answer: mostly safe. Breaks only if you depended on the old flags file or implicit client telemetry. Hosted server-side telemetry is unchanged. SDK client telemetry will be disabled unless explicitly opted in via config or env var. We built a 30-day grace period where the SDK will warn but still read the legacy file. After that it will ignore it.
amira: Shipping timeline: rc tomorrow, GA in 7 days. 30-day compatibility window begins at GA. During the window the SDK prints a clear deprecation warning to stderr and logs a migration URL. After 30 days the legacy file is ignored.
jen: Migration examples to add to docs (snippet copy):
Node opt-in:
```js
const {Client} = require('@redwood/sdk');
const c = new Client({telemetry:{enabled:true}});
```
Python opt-in (env):
```bash
export REDWOOD_SDK_TELEMETRY_OPT_IN=true
python app.py
```
New runtime config (CLI):
```bash
./app --runtime-config='{"enable_fast_kv":true,"quant_mode":"int8"}'
```
legacy file (DEPRECATED):
```json
{"enable_fast_kv": true, "quant_mode": "int8"}
```
ops: Note for Dedicated/Private: clusters that inject ~/.redwood/runtime-flags.json via config management need to switch to the CLI flag or set REDWOOD_RUNTIME_CONFIG_PATH to a mounted config. We added a management-console transformer to convert common keys — ops will run it for a subset of customers as part of the rollout.
dev-bot: Release artifacts: v4.1.0-rc3 pushed (sha a1b2c3d4). Integration tests kicked off.
docs-bot: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 contains migration checklist, helm snippets, and a troubleshooting FAQ. Please review the mobile section — a few repos still use the legacy file.
luis: Need comms for customers: brief exec blurb + CSM FAQ + short howto for mobile teams. CSMs want exact list of affected customers.
amira: Comms plan: day 0 announce here + in #customers; day 2 targeted email to Dedicated/Private users; day 7 GA + console banner; day 14 reminder and migration metrics for any opted-in telemetry. I'll draft the FAQ and exec blurb by EOD.
sara: Quick question: will telemetry opt-in allow sampling or tiered levels?
jen: Initial opt-in is boolean; we'll follow up with sampling controls in a follow-on release. SDK telemetry is minimal (client-side usage and env metadata) and can be toggled per-process or via env.
noah: DevEx ask: make opt-in example prominent in quickstarts and sdk init templates.
amira: Assigned to DevEx (jen + noah). I'll drop the list of files to update in #devex.
ops: Private packages: if you used KMS/HSM keys for telemetry, nothing changes — that config is untouched. This only disables automatic client-side telemetry payloads unless opted in.
luis: Please include mobile snippet and a migration checklist for CSMs.
jen: Adding mobile snippets to the docs PR now.
amira: Thanks all. If you see migration regressions in the compatibility job, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
